purpose: Protocol-only validation replay of the completed, unchanged 270-record nucleotide search; no second alignment, similarity calculation, grouping, phenotype access, training or scoring.
revision_reason: The executed v1 receipt rejected valid BLAST batch boundaries with 'Query appears after terminal completion'. Both original search commands exited zero. Preserve that failed receipt and its partial numeric output; validate the same completed raw bytes with per-batch counts and global unique query coverage.
completion_requirements: Every expected query occurs exactly once globally.
Each batch completion count equals its actual query count and each query's declared HSP count equals its observed count.
The sum of all completed batches is exactly 270, with no fixed choice of batch sizes.
The final nonblank record is a batch terminal marker.
Every nucleotide record has at least one self HSP under the unchanged executed v1 HSP validator.
Headerless output preserves every original HSP literal and row order; no coordinates, sequences, thresholds or numeric values change.
